newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends slightly lower vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends slightly lower vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down slightly at 8.2918 on Monday from last Friday's 8.2915 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai as some bankers sold the yuan to prevent it from approaching the 8.2910 level, traders said.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2917.
The yuan opened little changed at 8.2917 and moved in a narrow range between an intraday high of 8.2916 and a low of 8.2920 for the whole session.
Trading was dull with most business done at 8.2918, traders said.
One trader said sellers launched an attack to prevent the yuan from reaching 8.2910 after the local currency rose sharply on Friday.

"The selling was to prevent the yuan from hitting the 8.2910 level, and that is what kept it in a narrow range today," he said. "Buyers seemed to have no intention of pushing up the yuan on a lack of fresh stimuli."
A second trader said the yuan was expected to move narrowly this week after the sharp fluctations of last week.
Traders said they expected the yuan to move around 8.2920 on Tuesday.
The yuan closed down at an intraday low of 7.3653 from 7.2750 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly up at 1.0708 from 1.0710 against the Hong Kong dollar.
